submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 15 (Mn0.51Y0.49, next to the YMnO3 1:1 composition) gave the highest photocurrent, 5.8e-7 A. Moving away from it in either direction lowered the photocurrent, so the best composition is probably near 1:1.

rejected.reason: Mn0.66 (next to the YMn2O5 composition) gave -9e-8 A, so no useful photocurrent
Mn0.42 gave only 5e-8 A, far below index 15
